name: talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story
description: v0.2 phases 1-2: answerable prompts (jump key, decline, caret marker), --resume history, session switcher, absent_capability fix; every build unit cross-reviewed by the Codex engine; closed by a live acceptance run.

units.label: Reach and see: the F1 jump, card hint lines, focus styling
units.prompt: U1: Make every blocking-prompt card reachable in one F1 press and visibly focused when reached - extend focus_answer() to button cards, add the hint line and card focus styling. Verification includes driving F1 under tmux and one real terminal emulator (KTD9); if F1 is intercepted, record the ctrl+space fallback decision with the measurement. Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U1, KTD1/KTD9, R1/R2) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: Codex review of U1's diff
units.prompt: CR1: Drive the operator's herdr-managed Codex reviewer pane to review U1's diff, judge its findings, and return the ones that survive with file:line. Mechanics: resolve the reviewer pane via `herdr agent list` / `herdr tab list` using the machine-local identity the driver injects from the saga state; send the review request with `herdr pane send-text` (then `send-keys` Enter), wait for the agent to settle with `herdr pane wait-output` or agent_status polling, and read the reply with `herdr pane read --source recent-unwrapped` (a `visible` read presents stale content as a confident answer - do not use it). Capture the pane's reply verbatim as the review evidence (R11: an uncaptured review is treated as not having run). The unit's spec is docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md unit U1 (KTD10).

units.label: absent_capability stops blaming the gateway for a typo
units.prompt: U4: In talaria/transport/admin.py, disambiguate a 404 on a profile-carrying request by probing the bare path once with a bare GET, read method-aware: 2xx or 405 proves the route exists -> unknown_profile; 404 -> absent_capability; anything else reports the original error unchanged. NEVER probe with POST - a bare POST to /api/model/set would perform the mutation. Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U4, KTD7, R9) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: focus_session is made safe to call twice
units.worth_it_because: The settle-don't-drop policy for in-flight answer bookkeeping is the fix to the recorded uncorrelated-approval hole; getting it wrong renders a foreign session's prompt or makes a travelling approval stop counting - domain-invariant judgment, not mechanical edits.
units.prompt: U5: Harden focus_session before the switcher makes it live - reset withdrawn_approvals; REFUSE a switch while any answer RPC is in flight (a late outcome would mutate the wrong session's transcript); retain flushed_prompt_ids with synthesized approval ids qualified by session (the synthesis counter restarts per landing, so unqualified retention collides); session filter on prompt_view; correct the false docstring. Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U5, R8) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: Decline: escape on a card, and F4 finishing the job
units.worth_it_because: The only unit that changes what reaches the wire for credential prompts and approvals; the decline latch interacts with the restore path whose misdesign already produced two recorded defects, and an empty-choice approval decline needs semantics judged against the live bridge contract.
units.prompt: U2: Escape on a focused card declines with the kind's client-escape answer - explicit deny for approvals (the gateway's consumer treats any resolved non-deny choice, including empty, as APPROVED - never send an empty approval choice), empty field value for clarify/sudo/secret; decline follows the unchanged answer-outcome discipline (restore on definite not_sent, latch otherwise); a confirmed F4 interrupt sweeps per kind (one deny-all for approvals, empty answers for the rest, nothing for terminal_read); fold in the deny-all sweep latch. Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U2, KTD4/KTD8, R3/R4) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: --resume renders the conversation
units.worth_it_because: The release's central design question: projecting reply-carried history into the same transcript state the event stream feeds, with the messages element shape pinned from a live recording first - the compat baseline stops at the top level and the stub fixture is internally inconsistent.
units.prompt: U6: seed_history projects the session.resume reply's messages into committed transcript entries through a TYPED history decoder (text/tool/reasoning/display-metadata rows; malformed elements and unknown roles -> unknown-event posture, literal text, nothing dropped), with element fixtures pinned in a decoder contract test from recorded live replies (three exist in the local recordings set; capture fresh in the operator's testing terminal only for shapes they lack, cited by digest). _land_session reads messages/message_count/messages_omitted (the gateway's omission shape is an EMPTY messages array with the full message_count), retains BOTH the runtime session id and the durable resumed/session_key identity, seeds behind the landing barrier (seed before the pump consumes any event that followed the reply - pin with a reply-then-event back-to-back transport test), and begins a fresh transcript buffer when landing a different session (reconnect retention stays; update the reconciliation pin to distinguish the two). Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U6, KTD2/KTD3/KTD11, R6) as your authoritative spec.

units.prompt: U7: /sessions opens the modal picker over session.list (new read-only MethodBaseline first - updating the derived startup probe set and its pinned counts deliberately); rows identified and the focused session highlighted by the STORED session id; selection switches through session.resume -> _land_session; a switch refused while an answer is in flight surfaces as a notice; the local command shadows the catalogue's deliberately - extend the closed LocalAction type and its routing tests; record the KTD6 shadowing decision in DECISIONS.md in this unit's diff. units.label: The live acceptance run
units.prompt: U8: Author the live acceptance checklist for R1-R7 (naming the expected observation per leg), then drive it in the operator's herdr-managed testing pane - launch talaria there and exercise each requirement with `herdr pane send-keys` / `send-text`, reading the screen back with `herdr pane read --source recent-unwrapped` - with the operator supervising; produce the dated evidence document with recordings cited by digest. Safety envelope (mandatory): throwaway sessions only, never the operator's working sessions; no real credential is ever typed (the sudo leg declines; any answered leg uses a canary command that grants nothing); recordings are redaction-checked before citation; stop on the first failing leg rather than improvising; close what the run opened. The testing pane's machine-local identity is injected by the driver from the saga state. Read docs/plans/2026-08-08-talaria-v0-2-answerability-and-session-story-plan.md (unit U8, KTD11, R12) as your authoritative spec.
